fact: Decree No. 15/2018 of 15 May 2018 approved the by-laws of SENAPIQ-STP, the sole public entity managing the National Quality System (standardization, certification, accreditation, metrology), with powers to ratify and publish national standards and adopt international norms as domestic standards.
title: Decreto n.º 15/2018 - Estatutos do Serviço Nacional da Propriedade Intelectual e Qualidade (SENAPIQ-STP)
publisher: Diário da República, São Tomé e Príncipe
